AT0017.title: Multi-Instance Tools
AT0017.description: Multi-instance software allows running multiple clients of the same software simultaneously on one device, with each client operating normally. It is a tool that removes restrictions on single-instance software programs and games; unlike AT0002 mobile emulators which require a full virtual system, it enables multiple clients to run without a virtual machine.
